verses.original: עַתָּה֙ בַת־ גְּד֔וּד תִּתְגֹּדְדִ֣י מָצ֖וֹר שָׂ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ בַּשֵּׁ֙בֶט֙ יַכּ֣וּ עַֽל־ הַלְּחִ֔י אֵ֖ת שֹׁפֵ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ḇaṯ- gə·ḏūḏ tiṯ·gō·ḏə·ḏî mā·ṣō·wr śām ‘ā·lê·nū baš·šê·ḇeṭ yak·kū ‘al- hal·lə·ḥî ’êṯ šō·p̄êṭ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now O daughter of troops mobilize your troops for a siege is laid against us With a rod they will strike - the cheek - of the judge of Israel

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה בֵּֽית־ לֶ֣חֶם אֶפְרָ֗תָה לִֽהְיוֹת֙ צָעִיר֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמְּךָ֙ יֵצֵ֔א לִ֣י לִֽהְי֥וֹת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמוֹצָאֹתָ֥יו מִקֶּ֖דֶם מִימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh bêṯ- le·ḥem ’ep̄·rā·ṯāh lih·yō·wṯ ṣā·‘îr bə·’al·p̄ê yə·hū·ḏāh mim·mə·ḵā yê·ṣê lî lih·yō·wṯ mō·wō·šêl bə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·mō·w·ṣā·’ō·ṯāw miq·qe·ḏem mî·mê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: But you vvv Bethlehem Ephrathah who are small among the clans of Judah out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel One whose origins are of old from the days of eternity

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן יִתְּנֵ֔ם עַד־ עֵ֥ת יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָלָ֑דָה וְיֶ֣תֶר אֶחָ֔יו יְשׁוּב֖וּן עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yit·tə·nêm ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ yō·w·lê·ḏāh yā·lā·ḏāh wə·ye·ṯer ’e·ḥāw yə·šū·ḇūn ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore [Israel] will be abandoned until . . . she who is in labor has given birth then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel

verses.original: וְעָמַ֗ד וְרָעָה֙ בְּעֹ֣ז יְהוָ֔ה בִּגְא֕וֹן שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְיָשָׁ֕בוּ כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֥ה יִגְדַּ֖ל עַד־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·maḏ wə·rā·‘āh bə·‘ōz Yah·weh biḡ·’ō·wn šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·yā·šā·ḇū kî- ‘at·tāh yiḡ·dal ‘aḏ- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He will stand and shepherd [His flock] in the strength of the LORD in the majestic name of the LORD His God And they will dwell securely for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth

verses.original: זֶ֖ה וְהָיָ֥ה שָׁל֑וֹם כִּֽי־ אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֗נוּ וְכִ֤י יִדְרֹךְ֙ בְּאַרְמְנֹתֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲקֵמֹ֤נוּ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה נְסִיכֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zeh wə·hā·yāh šā·lō·wm kî- ’aš·šūr yā·ḇō·w ḇə·’ar·ṣê·nū wə·ḵî yiḏ·rōḵ bə·’ar·mə·nō·ṯê·nū wa·hă·qê·mō·nū ‘ā·lāw šiḇ·‘āh rō·‘îm ū·šə·mō·nāh nə·sî·ḵê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels We will raise against it seven shepherds even eight leaders of men

verses.original: וְרָע֞וּ אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ אַשּׁוּר֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ נִמְרֹ֖ד בִּפְתָחֶ֑יהָ וְהִצִּיל֙ כִּֽי־ מֵֽאַשּׁ֔וּר יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֔נוּ וְכִ֥י יִדְרֹ֖ךְ בִּגְבוּלֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·‘ū ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ ’aš·šūr ba·ḥe·reḇ wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ nim·rōḏ bip̄·ṯā·ḥe·hā wə·hiṣ·ṣîl kî- mê·’aš·šūr yā·ḇō·w ḇə·’ar·ṣê·nū wə·ḵî yiḏ·rōḵ biḡ·ḇū·lê·nū
verses.literal: And they will rule - the land of Assyria with the sword and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land and marches into our borders

verses.original: שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֗ב וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ רַבִּ֔ים עַמִּ֣ים כְּטַל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ עֵ֑שֶׂב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יְקַוֶּה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וְלֹ֥א יְיַחֵ֖ל לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ê·rîṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·hā·yāh bə·qe·reḇ rab·bîm ‘am·mîm kə·ṭal mê·’êṯ Yah·weh kir·ḇî·ḇîm ‘ă·lê- ‘ê·śeḇ ’ă·šer lō- yə·qaw·weh lə·’îš wə·lō yə·ya·ḥêl liḇ·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD like showers on the grass which do not wait for man or linger for mankind . . .

verses.original: שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יַעֲקֹ֜ב וְהָיָה֩ בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ רַבִּ֔ים עַמִּ֣ים כְּאַרְיֵה֙ בְּבַהֲמ֣וֹת יַ֔עַר כִּכְפִ֖יר בְּעֶדְרֵי צֹ֑אן אֲשֶׁ֧ר וְרָמַ֥ס וְטָרַ֖ף אִם עָבַ֛ר וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ê·rîṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·hā·yāh bag·gō·w·yim bə·qe·reḇ rab·bîm ‘am·mîm kə·’ar·yêh bə·ḇa·hă·mō·wṯ ya·‘ar kiḵ·p̄îr bə·ʿɛḏ·rē ṣōn ’ă·šer wə·rā·mas wə·ṭā·rap̄ ’im ‘ā·ḇar wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations in the midst of many peoples like a lion among the beasts of the forest like a young lion among flocks of sheep which tramples and tears as it passes through with no one to rescue them

verses.original: יָדְךָ֖ תָּרֹ֥ם עַל־ צָרֶ֑יךָ וְכָל־ אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃פ
verses.literal: Your hand will be lifted over your foes and all your enemies will be cut off

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הַהוּא֙ בַיּוֹם־ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י סוּסֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm- nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·hiḵ·rat·tî sū·se·ḵā miq·qir·be·ḵā wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî mar·kə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: - In that day declares the LORD I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהָרַסְתִּ֖י כָּל־ מִבְצָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י כְשָׁפִ֖ים מִיָּדֶ֑ךָ יִֽהְיוּ־ לָֽךְ׃ לֹ֥א וּֽמְעוֹנְנִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ḵə·šā·p̄îm mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā yih·yū- lāḵ lō ū·mə·‘ō·wn·nîm
verses.literal: I will cut the sorceries from your hand and you will have no fortune-tellers

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֧י פְסִילֶ֛יךָ וּמַצֵּבוֹתֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְלֹֽא־ ע֖וֹד תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî p̄ə·sî·le·ḵā ū·maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā miq·qir·be·ḵā wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh lə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands
I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי נָקָ֖ם אֶת־ בְּאַ֧ף וּבְחֵמָ֛ה הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî nā·qām ’eṯ- bə·’ap̄ ū·ḇə·ḥê·māh hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō šā·mê·‘ū
verses.literal: I will take vengeance . . . in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me
